Acceptable Use Policy

Version 2026-08-23

OpenCord is intended for lawful communication and community hosting. It must not be used to facilitate, coordinate, encourage, or conceal unlawful or seriously abusive activity.

Prohibited uses

  • Unauthorized access, credential theft, phishing, token theft, or stolen-account trafficking
  • Malware, ransomware, destructive code, botnets, cryptojacking, or command-and-control activity
  • Denial-of-service attacks or coordinated service disruption
  • Doxxing, swatting, stalking, extortion, credible threats, or targeted harassment
  • Fraud, scams, unlawful impersonation, money laundering, or trafficking in stolen property
  • Child sexual abuse material or sexual exploitation of minors
  • Human trafficking, illegal weapons trafficking, or unlawful controlled-substance trafficking
  • Identity theft or distribution of unlawfully obtained private data
  • Deliberately bypassing moderation or security controls for an unlawful purpose

Authorized security research, defensive administration, interoperability work, and lawful testing on systems you own or have permission to test are not prohibited.

Independent instances

Abuse on an independently hosted instance should normally be reported to that instance operator or the appropriate provider. OpenCord maintainers cannot moderate servers they do not operate and do not automatically receive their content or logs.
